translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
True or False?
It is possible to have negative values of
temperature in degrees kelvin.
back:
False.
It is not possible to have negative
values of temperature in degrees kelvin.
0 K is absolute zero, the lowest possible
temperature.
frontZh: 判断正误：开尔文温度可以出现负值。
backZh: 错误。开尔文温度不可能为负值。0 K 是绝对零度，是理论上的最低温度。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
True or False?
10 °C = 283 K
back:
True.
0 °C = 273 K, and an increase of 1 °C is
equal to an increase in 1 K. Therefore,
10 °C = 283 K
frontZh: 判断正误：10 °C = 283 K。
backZh: 正确。0 °C = 273 K，并且升高 1 °C 等于升高 1 K。因此 10 °C = 283 K。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
If the temperature of a gas remains
constant, what happens to the pressure
when the volume is decreased?
back:
If the temperature of a gas remains
constant, the pressure increases when
the volume is decreased.
frontZh: 如果气体温度保持不变，体积减小时压强会怎样变化？
backZh: 如果气体温度保持不变，体积减小时压强会增大。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
If the temperature of a gas in a balloon
remains constant, what happens to the
volume when the pressure is
decreased?
back:
If the temperature of a gas in a balloon
remains constant, the volume
increases when the pressure is
decreased.
frontZh: 如果气球中气体温度保持不变，压强减小时体积会怎样变化？
backZh: 如果气球中气体温度保持不变，压强减小时体积会增大。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
If the volume of a gas remains constant,
what happens to the pressure when the
temperature is increased?
back:
If the volume of a gas remains constant,
the pressure increases when the
temperature is increased.
frontZh: 如果气体体积保持不变，温度升高时压强会怎样变化？
backZh: 如果气体体积保持不变，温度升高时压强会增大。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
True or False?
The hotter the gas, the more energy the
gas particles have in their kinetic store.
back:
True.
The hotter the gas, the more energy the
gas particles have in their kinetic store.
frontZh: 判断正误：气体越热，气体粒子在动能储存中的能量越多。
backZh: 正确。气体越热，气体粒子的动能越大。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
True or False?
The cooler a gas is, the faster the gas
particles move around.
back:
False.
The cooler a gas is, the slower the gas
particles move around, because they
have less energy in their kinetic store.
frontZh: 判断正误：气体越冷，气体粒子运动越快。
backZh: 错误。气体越冷，气体粒子运动越慢，因为它们的动能更少。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
Define Boyle's law. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Boyle's law states that the pressure of a
gas at a constant temperature is
inversely proportional to its volume.
frontZh: 定义玻意耳定律。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 玻意耳定律说明：在温度恒定时，一定质量气体的压强与体积成反比。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
State the equation for Boyle's law.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The equation for Boyle's law is
P 1V 1 = P 2V 2
Where:
P 1 = initial pressure, measured in
pascals (Pa)
P 2 = final pressure, measured in
pascals (Pa)
V 1 = initial volume, measured in
metres cubed (m3)
V 2 = final volume, measured in
metres cubed (m3)
frontZh: 写出玻意耳定律的公式。（仅拓展内容）
backZh:
公式为 P₁V₁ = P₂V₂。
其中：
- P₁ 为初始压强，单位 Pa
- P₂ 为最终压强，单位 Pa
- V₁ 为初始体积，单位 m³
- V₂ 为最终体积，单位 m³
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

subtopicFull: T2.1 — Kinetic Particle Model of Matter
front:
What is the equation for Boyle's law in
terms of final volume? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The equation for Boyle's law in terms of
P 1V 1
final volume is V 2 = P
Where:
V 2 = final volume, measured in
metres cubed (m3)
P 1 = initial pressure, measured in
pascals (Pa)
P 2 = final pressure, measured in
pascals (Pa)
V 1 = initial volume, measured in
metres cubed (m3)
frontZh: 把玻意耳定律变形成最终体积 V₂ 的公式是什么？（仅拓展内容）
backZh:
公式为 V₂ = P₁V₁ / P₂。
其中：
- V₂ 为最终体积，单位 m³
- P₁ 为初始压强，单位 Pa
- P₂ 为最终压强，单位 Pa
- V₁ 为初始体积，单位 m³
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define thermal expansion.
back:
Thermal expansion occurs when
substances are heated due to the
increased movement of the particles in
the substance.
frontZh: 定义热膨胀。
backZh: 热膨胀是指物质被加热时，由于粒子运动加剧，整体尺寸增大的现象。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
When materials are heated they
contract.
back:
False.
When materials are heated they
expand.
frontZh: 判断正误：材料被加热时会收缩。
backZh: 错误。材料被加热时通常会膨胀。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
In thermal expansion, the size of the
particles increases.
back:
False.
The particles themselves do not
expand. The particles gain energy when
heated, so they move around faster
which causes the space between
particles to increase. This leads to the
overall expansion of the substance.
frontZh: 判断正误：热膨胀时粒子本身变大。
backZh: 错误。粒子本身不会膨胀。物质被加热时粒子获得能量，运动更快，粒子之间的距离增大，导致整个物质膨胀。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
When the temperature is increased
which substance expands the most?
back:
When the temperature is increased a
gas expands the most.
frontZh: 温度升高时，哪种物质状态膨胀最多？
backZh: 温度升高时，气体膨胀最多。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
In thermal expansion, solids expand
more than gases. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
In thermal expansion, gases expand the
most, then liquids, and solids expand
the least.
frontZh: 判断正误：热膨胀时，固体比气体膨胀得更多。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。热膨胀时，气体膨胀最多，其次是液体，固体膨胀最少。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Name two applications of thermal
expansion.
back:
The two applications of thermal
expansion that you need to know are:
thermometers
temperature activated switches
frontZh: 说出热膨胀的两个应用。
backZh:
需要知道的两个热膨胀应用是：
- 温度计
- 温度控制开关
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Railway tracks and bridges have gaps
built in to accommodate thermal
expansion.
back:
True.
Railway tracks and bridges do have gaps
built in to allow for the thermal
expansion of the materials.
frontZh: 判断正误：铁路轨道和桥梁中会留有空隙，以适应热膨胀。
backZh: 正确。铁路轨道和桥梁中会留有空隙，使材料热膨胀时有空间伸展。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term internal energy.
back:
Internal energy is the total energy of the
particles in a system due to their motion
and position.
frontZh: 定义内能。
backZh: 内能是系统中所有粒子由于运动和相互位置而具有的总能量。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The change in temperature of a
substance that is heated depends on
the mass of the substance.
back:
True.
The change in temperature of a
substance that is heated does depend
on the mass of the substance.
frontZh: 判断正误：被加热物质的温度变化取决于物质的质量。
backZh: 正确。被加热物质的温度变化确实取决于物质的质量。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What does the temperature increase
of a system depend upon?
back:
The temperature increase of a system
depends upon:
The mass of the substance heated
The type of material
The amount of thermal energy
transferred to the system
frontZh: 系统温度升高的多少取决于什么？
backZh:
系统温度升高的多少取决于：
- 被加热物质的质量
- 材料种类
- 转移到系统中的热能多少
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term specific heat capacity.
back:
The specific heat capacity of a
substance is the amount of energy
required to raise the temperature of 1
kg of the substance by 1 °C.
frontZh: 定义比热容。
backZh: 某物质的比热容是使 1 kg 该物质温度升高 1 °C 所需的能量。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
A substance with a low specific heat
capacity will heat up and cool down
slowly.
back:
False.
A substance with a low specific heat
capacity will heat up and cool down
quickly. It takes less energy to create a
temperature change.
frontZh: 判断正误：比热容低的物质升温和降温都较慢。
backZh: 错误。比热容低的物质升温和降温都较快，因为产生相同温度变化所需的能量较少。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Different substances have different
specific heat capacities.
back:
True.
Different substances have different
specific heat capacities.
frontZh: 判断正误：不同物质有不同的比热容。
backZh: 正确。不同物质有不同的比热容。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
State the equation for specific heat
capacity. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The equation for specific heat capacity
is ∆ E = mc ∆ θ
Where:
∆ E = change in energy, measured
in joules (J)
m = mass, measured in kilograms
(kg)
c = specific heat capacity,
measured in joules per kilogram
per degree Celsius (J/kg °C)
∆ θ = change in temperature,
measured in degrees Celsius (°C)
frontZh: 写出比热容公式。（仅拓展内容）
backZh:
公式为 ΔE = mcΔθ。
其中：
- ΔE 为能量变化，单位 J
- m 为质量，单位 kg
- c 为比热容，单位 J/(kg °C)
- Δθ 为温度变化，单位 °C
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording. QA: possible English residue ['mc'].
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the equation for specific heat
capacity when specific heat capacity is
the subject of the equation? (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
The equation for specific heat capacity
when specific heat capacity is the
subject of the equation is: c = ∆ E
m ∆ θ
Where:
c = specific heat capacity,
measured in joules per kilogram
per degree Celsius (J/kg °C)
m = mass, measured in kilograms
(kg)
∆ θ = change in temperature,
measured in degrees Celsius (°C)
∆ E = change in energy, measured
in joules (J)
frontZh: 当比热容 c 作为公式主项时，公式是什么？（仅拓展内容）
backZh:
公式为 c = ΔE / (mΔθ)。
其中：
- c 为比热容，单位 J/(kg °C)
- m 为质量，单位 kg
- Δθ 为温度变化，单位 °C
- ΔE 为能量变化，单位 J
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are the melting and boiling points
of pure water at standard atmospheric
pressure?
back:
Pure water ice melts at 0 °C, and pure
liquid water boils at 100 °C at standard
atmospheric pressure. These are known
as the fixed points of water.
frontZh: 标准大气压下纯水的熔点和沸点是多少？
backZh: 标准大气压下，纯冰在 0 °C 熔化，纯水在 100 °C 沸腾。这两个温度称为水的固定点。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Energy is transferred away from a
substance when it solidifies.
back:
True.
Energy is transferred away from a
substance when it solidifies.
frontZh: 判断正误：物质凝固时，能量从物质中转移出去。
backZh: 正确。物质凝固时，能量从物质中转移出去。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The temperature of a substance
increases while the substance is
melting.
back:
False.
The temperature of a substance does
not increase while the substance is
melting. There is no change in
temperature during a change of state.
The energy is used to change the state
of the substance rather than to increase
its temperature.
frontZh: 判断正误：物质熔化时温度会升高。
backZh: 错误。物质熔化时温度不升高。状态变化过程中温度保持不变，能量用于改变物质状态，而不是升高温度。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Liquids freeze at the melting point of
the substance.
back:
True.
Liquids do freeze at the melting point of
the substance. The state change
between solids and liquids occurs at the
melting point.
frontZh: 判断正误：液体在该物质的熔点处凝固。
backZh: 正确。液体会在该物质的熔点处凝固。固体和液体之间的状态变化发生在熔点。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Gases condense at the boiling point of
the substance.
back:
True.
Gases do condense at the boiling point
of the substance. The state change
between liquids and gases occurs at the
boiling point of the substance.
frontZh: 判断正误：气体在该物质的沸点处凝结。
backZh: 正确。气体会在该物质的沸点处凝结。液体和气体之间的状态变化发生在沸点。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
When a substance is melting or boiling,
why does the temperature of the
substance not change even though
energy is being transferred into the
system? proximity, rather than increasing the
back:
The energy transferred into a substance
that is melting or boiling is used to
overcome the intermolecular forces of
attraction holding the particles in close
temperature of the substance.
frontZh: 物质熔化或沸腾时，为什么即使能量转移进入系统，温度也不变？
backZh: 转移进入物质的能量用于克服使粒子靠近的分子间吸引力，而不是用于升高物质的温度。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Freezing and melting happen at the
same temperature.
back:
True.
Freezing and melting do happen at the
same temperature, the melting point of
the substance.
frontZh: 判断正误：凝固和熔化发生在相同温度。
backZh: 正确。凝固和熔化发生在相同温度，即该物质的熔点。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term evaporation.
back:
Evaporation is the change of state from
a liquid to a gas. It happens at any
temperature and only from the surface
of the liquid.
frontZh: 定义蒸发。
backZh: 蒸发是液体变成气体的状态变化。蒸发可在任何温度下发生，并且只发生在液体表面。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Evaporation results in the heating of a
liquid.
back:
False.
Evaporation results in the cooling of a
liquid.
frontZh: 判断正误：蒸发会使液体升温。
backZh: 错误。蒸发会使液体冷却。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: How does evaporation occur?
back:
Evaporation occurs when more
energetic particles at the surface of
the liquid overcome the intermolecular
forces of attraction holding them in
close proximity.
frontZh: 蒸发是怎样发生的？
backZh: 当液体表面能量较高的粒子克服分子间吸引力并逃离液体时，就发生蒸发。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are the three steps in the cooling
effect of evaporation?
back:
Evaporation cools a substance because:
The more energetic particles at the
surface escape the liquid.
This reduces the average energy
of the particles in the liquid.
Since temperature is a measure of
the average kinetic energy of the
particles in a substance, the
temperature decreases and the
substance is cooled.
frontZh: 蒸发产生冷却效应的三个步骤是什么？
backZh:
蒸发使物质冷却，因为：
- 液体表面能量较高的粒子逃离液体
- 液体中粒子的平均能量降低
- 温度表示粒子的平均动能，因此温度降低，物质被冷却
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are the factors affecting the rate
of evaporation? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The factors affecting the rate of
evaporation are:
temperature
surface area
air movement
frontZh: 影响蒸发速率的因素有哪些？（仅拓展内容）
backZh:
影响蒸发速率的因素包括：
- 温度
- 表面积
- 空气流动
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the difference between boiling
and evaporation? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Boiling only happens at the boiling
point of a substance, and it occurs
throughout the liquid. Evaporation
can occur at any temperature and it
only happens at the surface of a liquid.
frontZh: 沸腾和蒸发有什么区别？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 沸腾只在物质的沸点发生，并且发生在整个液体内部；蒸发可以在任何温度下发生，但只发生在液体表面。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Objects can be cooled when a liquid
evaporates from the surface of an
object. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Objects can be cooled when a liquid
evaporates from the surface of an
object. For example, when sweat
evaporates from the skin:
Energy is transferred from the
warmer skin to the cooler liquid.
The more energetic particles at the
surface of the liquid escape
reducing the average energy of the
liquid.
This increases the temperature
difference between the skin and
the liquid so more energy is
transferred from the skin to the
liquid.
This process has a cooling effect
on the skin.
frontZh: 判断正误：液体从物体表面蒸发时，可以使物体冷却。（仅拓展内容）
backZh:
正确。液体从物体表面蒸发时可以使物体冷却。例如汗液从皮肤表面蒸发时：
- 能量从较暖的皮肤转移到较冷的液体
- 液体表面能量较高的粒子逃离，使液体平均能量降低
- 皮肤和液体之间的温差增大，使更多能量从皮肤转移到液体
- 这个过程对皮肤产生冷却作用
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Define thermal conduction.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Thermal conduction is the transfer of
thermal energy through a substance.
frontZh: 定义热传导。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 热传导是热能通过物质传递的过程。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Thermal conduction in solids occurs
when hotter, more energetic atoms or
ions vibrate faster and collide with
neighbouring atoms or ions. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
True.
Thermal conduction in solids occurs
when hotter, more energetic atoms or
ions vibrate faster and collide with
neighbouring atoms or ions,
transferring energy throughout the
structure of the solid.
frontZh: 判断正误：固体中的热传导发生在较热、能量较高的原子或离子振动更快，并与相邻原子或离子碰撞时。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。固体中较热、能量较高的原子或离子振动更快，并与相邻原子或离子碰撞，从而把能量传递到整个固体结构中。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Why does thermal conduction generally
occur faster in metals than non-metals?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Thermal conduction occurs faster in
metals because metals have free
(delocalised) electrons, which speed up
the energy transfer throughout the
substance.
frontZh: 为什么金属中的热传导通常比非金属快？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 金属中有自由电子（离域电子），它们可以更快地把能量传递到整个物质中，因此金属导热更快。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
When does thermal conduction end?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Thermal conduction ends when thermal
equilibrium is reached.
frontZh: 热传导什么时候结束？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 当达到热平衡时，热传导结束。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Define thermal equilibrium.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
Thermal equilibrium is a state in which
no net energy transfer takes place
because a consistent temperature has
been reached.
frontZh: 定义热平衡。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 热平衡是指温度达到一致后，没有净能量转移的状态。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Thermal conduction does not happen in
liquids or gases because the particles
are too far apart. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Thermal conduction does happen in
liquids and gases, but they tend to be
poor conductors because the particles
are further apart than in solids.
frontZh: 判断正误：液体和气体中不会发生热传导，因为粒子相距太远。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。液体和气体中也会发生热传导，但由于粒子比固体中相距更远，所以它们通常是较差的热导体。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Convection cannot happen in solids.
back:
True.
Convection only happens in liquids and
gases because the particles are free to
move around. It cannot happen in
solids because the particles are held in
a rigid structure.
frontZh: 判断正误：固体中不能发生对流。
backZh: 正确。对流只发生在液体和气体中，因为这些粒子可以自由移动。固体中的粒子被固定在刚性结构中，因此不能发生对流。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
How is a convection current set up
when a fluid is heated?
back:
When a fluid is heated, the space
between particles increases, so the
density of the fluid decreases which
causes it to rise, and cooler, denser fluid
takes its place.
frontZh: 流体被加热时，对流是怎样形成的？
backZh: 流体被加热时，粒子间距离增大，流体密度减小并上升；较冷、密度较大的流体随后流过来取代它。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
In a convection current hot fluid
expands and rises. What is this
replaced by?
back:
In a convection current hot fluid
expands and rises. In a convection
current, this is replaced by cooler,
denser fluid.
frontZh: 对流中热流体膨胀并上升后，会被什么取代？
backZh: 热流体膨胀并上升后，会被较冷、密度较大的流体取代。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What substance is used as a purple dye
to demonstrate convection in water?
back:
Potassium permanganate is used as a
purple dye to demonstrate convection
in water.
frontZh: 用什么紫色染料演示水中的对流？
backZh: 可以用高锰酸钾作为紫色染料来演示水中的对流。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Heat rises.
back:
False.
Heat is not a substance so it cannot rise.
It is the heated region of the fluid that
rises as its density decreases.
frontZh: 判断正误：热会上升。
backZh: 错误。热不是物质，所以热本身不会上升。上升的是被加热后密度减小的流体区域。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Convection currents form when a fluid
is cooled.
back:
True.
When a fluid is cooled, the movement of
the particles slows down and they come
closer together increasing the density.
The denser fluid sinks and less dense
fluid takes its place.
frontZh: 判断正误：流体被冷却时会形成对流。
backZh: 正确。流体被冷却时，粒子运动减慢并靠得更近，密度增大。密度较大的流体下沉，密度较小的流体流来取代它。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
All objects emit thermal radiation.
back:
True.
All objects emit thermal radiation. The
hotter an object is, the more thermal
radiation it emits.
frontZh: 判断正误：所有物体都会发出热辐射。
backZh: 正确。所有物体都会发出热辐射。物体越热，发出的热辐射越多。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The colour of an object affects its ability
to emit and absorb radiation.
back:
True.
The colour of an object does affect its
ability to emit and absorb thermal
radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：物体的颜色会影响它发射和吸收辐射的能力。
backZh: 正确。物体表面颜色会影响它发射和吸收热辐射的能力。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Thermal radiation requires a medium to
travel through.
back:
False.
Thermal radiation is an
electromagnetic wave, so it can travel
through a vacuum.
frontZh: 判断正误：热辐射传播需要介质。
backZh: 错误。热辐射是电磁波，因此可以在真空中传播。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What type of electromagnetic wave is
thermal radiation?
back: Thermal radiation is infrared radiation.
frontZh: 热辐射属于哪种电磁波？
backZh: 热辐射是红外辐射。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
In terms of the rate of energy transfer,
how does an object maintain a constant
temperature? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
An object maintains a constant
temperature when the rate of energy
transfer away from the object is equal
to the rate of energy transfer to the
object.
frontZh: 从能量转移速率角度看，物体怎样保持恒温？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 当物体向外转移能量的速率等于它接收能量的速率时，物体温度保持不变。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
White surfaces are good emitters and
good absorbers of thermal radiation.
back:
False.
White surfaces are poor emitters and
poor absorbers of thermal radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：白色表面是热辐射的良好发射体和良好吸收体。
backZh: 错误。白色表面既不是良好的热辐射发射体，也不是良好的热辐射吸收体。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
When an object emits less thermal
radiation than it absorbs, its
temperature increases. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
When an object emits less thermal
radiation than it absorbs, its
temperature increases.
frontZh: 判断正误：当物体发出的热辐射少于吸收的热辐射时，温度会升高。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。当物体发出的热辐射少于吸收的热辐射时，温度会升高。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What colour surface is the best emitter
of thermal radiation?
back:
Black surfaces are the best emitters of
thermal radiation.
frontZh: 哪种颜色的表面最善于发射热辐射？
backZh: 黑色表面最善于发射热辐射。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Shiny surfaces are very good emitters of
thermal radiation.
back:
False.
Shiny surfaces are very poor emitters of
thermal radiation. They are also very
poor absorbers because they reflect the
infrared radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：有光泽的表面是非常好的热辐射发射体。
backZh: 错误。有光泽的表面是很差的热辐射发射体，也很差的吸收体，因为它们会反射红外辐射。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
When an object emits more thermal
radiation than it absorbs, its
temperature increases. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
False.
When an object emits more thermal
radiation than it absorbs, its
temperature decreases.
frontZh: 判断正误：当物体发出的热辐射多于吸收的热辐射时，温度会升高。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。当物体发出的热辐射多于吸收的热辐射时，温度会降低。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
If the Earth had no atmosphere, the
temperature on the surface would
remain the same as it is currently.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
If the Earth had no atmosphere, the
temperature on the surface would drop
to about −180 °C at night, the same as
that of the Moon at night.
frontZh: 判断正误：如果地球没有大气层，地表温度会保持和现在一样。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。如果地球没有大气层，夜晚地表温度会下降到约 −180 °C，接近月球夜晚的温度。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Define the Greenhouse Effect .
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The Greenhouse Effect is the process by
which certain gases in the Earth's
atmosphere trap and reradiate infrared
radiation, leading to an increase in the
temperature of the Earth's surface.
frontZh: 定义温室效应。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 温室效应是指地球大气中的某些气体吸收并重新辐射红外辐射，使地表温度升高的过程。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are the factors affecting the
Earth's temperature? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The factors affecting the Earth's
temperature are the rate of reflection ,
absorption, and emission of light and
infrared radiation from the Sun.
frontZh: 影响地球温度的因素有哪些？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 影响地球温度的因素包括太阳光和红外辐射的反射、吸收和发射速率。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The Earth receives thermal radiation
from the Sun but does not emit its own
thermal radiation. (Extended Tier
Only) emit thermal radiation.
back:
False.
The Earth receives thermal radiation
from the Sun and emits its own thermal
radiation. Remember that all objects
frontZh: 判断正误：地球接收来自太阳的热辐射，但不会发出自己的热辐射。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。地球接收来自太阳的热辐射，也会发出自己的热辐射。所有物体都会发出热辐射。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Define Greenhouse Gases. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
Greenhouse gases are gases in the
atmosphere that absorb and reradiate
longer-wavelength infrared radiation
emitted by the Earth, preventing it from
escaping into space, and causing
warming of the Earth's surface.
frontZh: 定义温室气体。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 温室气体是大气中能吸收并重新辐射地球发出的长波红外辐射的气体，从而阻止部分能量逃逸到太空，使地表变暖。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
How does the Greenhouse Effect cause
warming of the Earth's surface?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
The Greenhouse Effect causes warming
of the Earth's surface because of the
Sun's thermal radiation reaching the
Earth's atmosphere. Here some
radiation is reflected back into space,
and the rest is absorbed and reradiated
by greenhouse gases, warming the
atmosphere and Earth's surface.
frontZh: 温室效应怎样使地表变暖？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 太阳的热辐射到达地球大气层时，一部分被反射回太空，其余被吸收并由温室气体重新辐射，从而使大气和地表变暖。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is an example of a greenhouse
gas? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Examples of greenhouse gases are:
carbon dioxide
methane (natural gas)
water vapour
frontZh: 举出一种温室气体。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 温室气体的例子包括：二氧化碳、甲烷（天然气）和水蒸气。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V10 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The electromagnetic spectrum is
arranged in a specific order based on
the wavelengths or frequencies.
back:
True.
The electromagnetic spectrum is
arranged in a specific order based on
the wavelengths or frequencies.
frontZh: 判断正误：电磁波谱按照波长或频率以特定顺序排列。
backZh: 正确。电磁波谱按照波长或频率以特定顺序排列。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the order of the
electromagnetic spectrum from longest
to shortest wavelength?
back:
The order of the electromagnetic
spectrum from longest to shortest
wavelength is:
Radio waves
Microwaves
Infrared
Visible light
Ultraviolet
X-rays
Gamma rays
frontZh: 按波长从最长到最短排列电磁波谱的顺序是什么？
backZh: 电磁波谱按波长从最长到最短的顺序为：无线电波、微波、红外线、可见光、紫外线、X 射线、伽马射线。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are the properties of
electromagnetic waves?
back:
All electromagnetic waves share the
following properties:
transverse
can through a vacuum
travel at the same speed in a
vacuum
form a continuous spectrum
frontZh: 电磁波有哪些共同性质？
backZh: 所有电磁波都具有以下性质：都是横波；可以在真空中传播；在真空中以相同速率传播；形成连续的波谱。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Define the term electromagnetic
waves.
back:
Electromagnetic waves are transverse
waves with oscillating electric and
magnetic fields that transfer energy
from the source of the waves to an
absorber.
frontZh: 定义术语“电磁波”。
backZh: 电磁波是由振荡的电场和磁场组成的横波，能把能量从波源传递到吸收体。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The speed of electromagnetic waves in
air is the same as in a vacuum.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
The speed of electromagnetic waves in
air can be approximated to the speed of
light in a vacuum because the
difference in speed is so small.
frontZh: 判断正误：空气中电磁波的速率与真空中相同。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。空气中电磁波的速率可近似看作真空中的光速，因为二者差别很小。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the relationship between the
frequency of electromagnetic waves
and the energy they transfer?
back:
The higher the frequency, the higher
the energy of the radiation, and vice
versa.
frontZh: 电磁波频率与它们传递的能量之间有什么关系？
backZh: 频率越高，辐射传递的能量越大；反之，频率越低，能量越小。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is a mnemonic for remembering
the order of radiation types in the
electromagnetic spectrum?
back:
One possible mnemonic for
remembering the electromagnetic
spectrum is:
Raging Martians Invaded Venus Using
X-ray Guns.
frontZh: 有什么助记句可以帮助记住电磁波谱的顺序？
backZh: 一种助记句是：Raging Martians Invaded Venus Using X-ray Guns。对应顺序为 Radio、Microwave、Infrared、Visible、Ultraviolet、X-ray、Gamma。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording. QA: contains possible English abbreviation/term; acceptable if intentional (e.g. LDR, d.c., a.c., I-V, kWh). QA: possible English residue ['Gamma', 'Guns', 'Infrared', 'Invaded', 'Martians', 'Microwave', 'Radio', 'Raging', 'Ultraviolet', 'Using', 'Venus', 'Visible', 'ray']. QA: possible English residue ['Gamma', 'Guns', 'Infrared', 'Invaded', 'Martians', 'Microwave', 'Radio', 'Raging', 'Ultraviolet', 'Using', 'Venus', 'Visible', 'ray'].
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Identify using the diagram the
electromagnetic radiation type with the
shortest wavelength.
back:
The electromagnetic radiation type with
the shortest wavelength is gamma
rays.
frontZh: 根据图示，指出波长最短的电磁辐射类型。
backZh: 波长最短的电磁辐射是伽马射线。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Identify using the diagram the
electromagnetic radiation type with the
highest frequency.
back:
The electromagnetic radiation type with
the highest frequency is gamma rays.
frontZh: 根据图示，指出频率最高的电磁辐射类型。
backZh: 频率最高的电磁辐射是伽马射线。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term fluorescence .
back:
Fluorescence is the process where
certain substances absorb ultraviolet
light and re-emit it as visible light,
causing them to glow.
frontZh: 定义术语“荧光”。
backZh: 荧光是某些物质吸收紫外线后，再以可见光形式重新发射出来，从而发光的过程。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the main application of radio
waves?
back:
The main application of radio waves is
in wireless communications.
frontZh: 无线电波的主要应用是什么？
backZh: 无线电波的主要应用是无线通信。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are the two main applications of
microwaves?
back:
The two main applications of
microwaves are:
heating food
wireless communications
frontZh: 微波的两个主要应用是什么？
backZh: 微波的两个主要应用是加热食物和无线通信。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Night vision cameras use infrared
radiation.
back:
True.
One application of infrared radiation is
night vision cameras.
frontZh: 判断正误：夜视摄像机使用红外辐射。
backZh: 正确。红外辐射的一个应用是夜视摄像机。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Gamma radiation is used in fibre optic
communications.
back:
False.
Infrared and visible light are used in
optic fibre communications. Gamma
rays are used for sterilising medical
equipment and treating cancer.
frontZh: 判断正误：伽马射线用于光纤通信。
backZh: 错误。光纤通信使用红外线和可见光。伽马射线可用于医疗器械消毒和治疗癌症。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Sterilising water and detecting fake
bank notes are two applications of X-
rays.
back:
False.
Sterilising water and detecting fake
bank notes are two applications of
ultraviolet radiation (UV). X-rays are
used for imaging in medicine, dentistry,
airport security and industry.
frontZh: 判断正误：水的消毒和假钞检测是 X 射线的两个应用。
backZh: 错误。水的消毒和假钞检测是紫外线（UV）的应用。X 射线用于医学、牙科、机场安检和工业成像。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Visible light is the only part of the
electromagnetic spectrum that human
eyes can see.
back:
True.
Human eyes can only detect
wavelengths of electromagnetic
radiation in the visible light section of
the electromagnetic spectrum.
frontZh: 判断正误：可见光是电磁波谱中人眼唯一能看见的部分。
backZh: 正确。人眼只能探测电磁波谱中可见光范围内的电磁辐射。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Remote controls are one application of
ultraviolet radiation.
back:
False.
Ultraviolet radiation carries too much
energy and would be harmful if used for
this purpose. Remote controls are one
application of infrared radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：遥控器是紫外线辐射的一个应用。
backZh: 错误。紫外线能量较高，用于遥控器会有害。遥控器使用红外辐射。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
State the type of radiation used in the
device in the diagram.
back:
The device in the diagram is a
microwave oven and uses microwaves.
frontZh: 说出图中装置使用的辐射类型。
backZh: 图中装置是微波炉，使用微波。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
As the frequency of electromagnetic
waves increases, so does the energy
and the danger associated with them.
back:
True.
As the frequency of electromagnetic
waves increases, the energy they
transfer increases, and therefore so
does the danger associated with them.
frontZh: 判断正误：电磁波频率越高，能量和相关危险也越大。
backZh: 正确。电磁波频率越高，传递的能量越大，因此相关危险也越大。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the main danger associated
with ultraviolet, X-rays, and gamma
rays?
back:
Ultraviolet, X-rays, and gamma rays can
all ionise atoms, which can damage
cells and cause mutations, which can
lead to cancer.
frontZh: 紫外线、X 射线和伽马射线的主要危险是什么？
backZh: 紫外线、X 射线和伽马射线都能使原子电离，可能损伤细胞并导致突变，进而可能导致癌症。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Radio waves are known to be harmful
to humans.
back:
False.
There are no known harmful effects of
radio waves.
frontZh: 判断正误：无线电波已知会对人体有害。
backZh: 错误。目前没有已知的无线电波有害影响。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Microwaves can be harmful to humans.
back:
True.
Microwaves can be harmful to humans
in high levels of exposure, because
higher-frequency microwaves cause
internal heating.
frontZh: 判断正误：微波可能对人体有害。
backZh: 正确。在高暴露水平下，微波可能对人体有害，因为较高频率的微波会导致体内加热。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Mobile phones emit microwave
radiation.
back:
True.
Mobile phones do emit microwave
radiation, but only at low energies
which are not known to cause any
harm.
frontZh: 判断正误：手机会发射微波辐射。
backZh: 正确。手机会发射微波辐射，但能量较低，目前没有已知证据表明会造成伤害。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Ultraviolet radiation can be harmful to
humans.
back:
True.
Ultraviolet radiation can cause sunburn,
eye damage and skin cancer.
frontZh: 判断正误：紫外线辐射可能对人体有害。
backZh: 正确。紫外线辐射可能导致晒伤、眼睛损伤和皮肤癌。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
X-rays and gamma rays can be harmful
to humans.
back:
True.
X-rays and gamma rays (and UV) are
ionising radiation which can remove
electrons from atoms, causing damage
to DNA which can lead to cell and tissue
damage, mutations and cancer.
frontZh: 判断正误：X 射线和伽马射线可能对人体有害。
backZh: 正确。X 射线和伽马射线（以及紫外线）属于电离辐射，能从原子中移走电子，可能损伤 DNA，导致细胞和组织损伤、突变和癌症。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording. QA: possible English residue ['DNA'].
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Sunscreen absorbs ultraviolet light,
preventing it from damaging the skin.
back:
True.
Sunscreen absorbs ultraviolet light,
preventing it from damaging the skin.
frontZh: 判断正误：防晒霜吸收紫外线，从而防止紫外线伤害皮肤。
backZh: 正确。防晒霜吸收紫外线，减少紫外线对皮肤的伤害。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Ionising forms of electromagnetic
radiation have a higher frequency than
visible light.
back:
True.
The ionising forms of electromagnetic
radiation are ultraviolet, X-rays and
gamma rays, all of which have higher
frequencies than visible light.
frontZh: 判断正误：电离形式的电磁辐射频率高于可见光。
backZh: 正确。电离形式的电磁辐射包括紫外线、X 射线和伽马射线，它们的频率都高于可见光。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The longer the wavelength, the more
ionising the electromagnetic radiation.
back:
False.
The shorter the wavelength (and
therefore, the higher the frequency),
the more ionising the electromagnetic
radiation.
frontZh: 判断正误：波长越长，电磁辐射的电离能力越强。
backZh: 错误。波长越短（因此频率越高），电磁辐射的电离能力越强。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
State the purpose of the device in the
image.
back:
The device in the image is a radiation
badge and its purpose is to measure a
person's exposure to radiation.
frontZh: 说出图中装置的用途。
backZh: 图中装置是辐射剂量牌，用来测量一个人受到辐射照射的程度。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is a geostationary satellite?
back:
A geostationary satellite is a satellite
that orbits above the Earth's equator.
frontZh: 什么是地球同步卫星？
backZh: 地球同步卫星是在地球赤道上方绕地球运行的卫星。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the orbital period of a
geostationary satellite?
back:
The orbital period of a geostationary
satellite is 24 hours.
frontZh: 地球同步卫星的轨道周期是多少？
backZh: 地球同步卫星的轨道周期是 24 小时。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Polar satellites orbit higher above the
Earth's surface than geostationary
satellites.
back:
False.
Geostationary satellites orbit much
higher above the Earth's surface than
polar satellites do.
frontZh: 判断正误：极地卫星比地球同步卫星在更高的轨道上运行。
backZh: 错误。地球同步卫星比极地卫星在更高的轨道上运行。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are geostationary satellites used
for?
back:
The high orbit of geostationary satellites
makes them useful for radio and
telecommunications broadcasting
around the world.
frontZh: 地球同步卫星有什么用途？
backZh: 地球同步卫星的高轨道使它们适用于全球范围的无线电和电信广播。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is a polar satellite?
back:
A polar satellite is a satellite that orbits
around the Earth's north and south
poles.
frontZh: 什么是极地卫星？
backZh: 极地卫星是绕地球南北两极附近运行的卫星。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Polar satellites are also known as low-
orbit satellites.
back:
True.
Polar satellites are also known as low-
orbit satellites because they orbit much
closer to the Earth's surface than
geostationary satellites.
frontZh: 判断正误：极地卫星也称为低轨道卫星。
backZh: 正确。极地卫星也称为低轨道卫星，因为它们比地球同步卫星更靠近地球表面运行。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What are polar satellites used for?
back:
Polar satellites are used for:
monitoring the weather
military applications
taking images of the Earth's surface
frontZh: 极地卫星有什么用途？
backZh: 极地卫星可用于监测天气、军事应用，以及拍摄地球表面图像。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Why are polar satellites used for
military applications rather than
geostationary satellites?
back:
Polar satellites have a lower orbit,
therefore there is a much shorter time
delay between sending and receiving
signals, and the images are much
clearer. This makes polar satellites more
suitable for certain applications
including military use.
frontZh: 为什么军事应用中使用极地卫星而不是地球同步卫星？
backZh: 极地卫星轨道较低，所以信号发送和接收之间的时间延迟更短，图像也更清晰。这使它们更适合某些应用，包括军事用途。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Why are microwaves used for wireless
internet? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Microwaves are used for wireless
internet (WiFi) because microwaves can
penetrate some walls and only require a
short ariel for transmission and
reception.
frontZh: 为什么微波用于无线互联网？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 微波用于无线互联网（WiFi），因为微波能穿透一些墙壁，并且发射和接收只需要较短的天线。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording. QA: possible English residue ['WiFi']. QA: possible English residue ['WiFi'].
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Why are radio waves used for
Bluetooth? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
Radio waves can pass through walls but
the signal is weakened by doing so,
therefore radio waves are useful for
very short-range communications such
as Bluetooth.
frontZh: 为什么无线电波用于蓝牙？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 无线电波可以穿过墙壁，但信号会减弱。因此，无线电波适用于蓝牙等非常短距离的通信。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The value of an analogue signal can
vary continuously. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
The value of analogue signals can vary
continuously. They can take any value.
frontZh: 判断正误：模拟信号的数值可以连续变化。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。模拟信号的数值可以连续变化，可以取任意值。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What type of signal can only take one of
two discrete states? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
Digital signals can only take discrete
states such as:
1 and 0
high and low
on and off
frontZh: 哪种信号只能取两个离散状态之一？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 数字信号只能取离散状态，例如：1 和 0、高和低、开和关。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
One advantage of a digital signal over
an analogue signal is that a digital signal
can be regenerated so there is minimal
noise. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
A digital signal can be regenerated
(restored to its original characteristics)
so there is minimal noise (unwanted
disturbance in the signal). This increases
the range of the signal so it can be
transmitted over larger distances.
frontZh: 判断正误：数字信号相对于模拟信号的一个优点是可以再生，因此噪声很小。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。数字信号可以再生（恢复到原来的特征），所以噪声（信号中的不需要的干扰）很小。这增加了信号范围，使其能传输更远距离。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term amplitude.
back:
Amplitude is the distance from the
undisturbed position to the peak or
trough of a wave.
frontZh: 定义术语“振幅”。
backZh: 振幅是从平衡位置到波峰或波谷的距离。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is wavelength?
back:
Wavelength is the distance from one
point on the wave to the same point on
the next wave.
frontZh: 什么是波长？
backZh: 波长是波上某一点到下一个波上对应相同位置的距离，例如从一个波峰到下一个波峰的距离。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term frequency.
back:
Frequency is the number of waves
passing a point in a second.
frontZh: 定义术语“频率”。
backZh: 频率是每秒通过某一点的波的个数。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term wave speed.
back:
Wave speed is the speed at which a
wave travels.
frontZh: 定义术语“波速”。
backZh: 波速是波传播的速率。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is a wavefront?
back:
A wavefront is a way of picturing waves
as if from above, where each wavefront
represents the peak of a single wave.
frontZh: 什么是波前？
backZh: 波前是一种从上方俯视表示波的方法；每一条波前通常表示一个波峰的位置。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is a ripple tank used for?
back:
A ripple tank is used to demonstrate
wave motion.
frontZh: 水波槽有什么用途？
backZh: 水波槽用于演示波的运动和波的行为。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is the symbol used for amplitude?
back: The symbol used for amplitude is A .
frontZh: 振幅使用什么符号？
backZh: 振幅的符号是 A。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What are the units of amplitude?
back: The units of amplitude are metres (m).
frontZh: 振幅的单位是什么？
backZh: 振幅的单位是米（m）。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Draw and label amplitude and
wavelength on a diagram of a
transverse wave.
back:
Amplitude and wavelength drawn on
a diagram of a transverse wave look like
this:
frontZh: 在横波图上画出并标注振幅和波长。
backZh: 在横波图中，振幅应从平衡位置量到波峰或波谷；波长应量相邻两个对应点之间的距离。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Identify the wave property indicated by
the arrow on the diagram.
back:
The wave property indicated by the
arrow on the diagram is time period.
frontZh: 指出图中箭头表示的波的物理量。
backZh: 图中箭头表示的波的物理量是周期。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What are the units of wave speed?
back:
The units of wave speed are metres per
second (m/s).
frontZh: 波速的单位是什么？
backZh: 波速的单位是米每秒（m/s）。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is the symbol for wave speed?
back: The symbol for wave speed is v .
frontZh: 波速的符号是什么？
backZh: 波速的符号是 v。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The symbol for frequency is λ .
back:
False.
The symbol for frequency is f .
frontZh: 判断正误：频率的符号是 λ。
backZh: 错误。频率的符号是 f。λ 是波长的符号。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The units of frequency are hertz (Hz).
back:
True.
The units of frequency are hertz (Hz)
frontZh: 判断正误：频率的单位是赫兹（Hz）。
backZh: 正确。频率的单位是赫兹（Hz）。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What are the units for wavelength?
back:
The units for wavelength are metres
(m).
frontZh: 波长的单位是什么？
backZh: 波长的单位是米（m）。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is the symbol for wavelength?
back: The symbol for wavelength is λ .
frontZh: 波长的符号是什么？
backZh: 波长的符号是 λ。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
State the wave equation in terms of
wave speed.
back:
The wave equation in terms of wave
speed is v = fλ
Where:
v = wave speed, measured in
metres per second (m/s)
f = frequency, measured in hertz
(Hz)
λ = wavelength, measured in
metres (m)
frontZh: 写出用波速表示的波公式。
backZh: 波速公式为 v = fλ。其中：v 为波速，单位 m/s；f 为频率，单位 Hz；λ 为波长，单位 m。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The wave speed equation in terms of
wavelength is λ = f .
v
back:
False.
The wave speed equation in terms of
wavelength is λ = v
f
Where:
λ = wavelength, measured in
metres (m)
v = wave speed, measured in
metres per second (m/s)
f = frequency, measured in hertz
(Hz)
frontZh: 判断正误：由波速公式变形得到波长为 λ = f / v。
backZh: 错误。由 v = fλ 得到 λ = v / f。其中：λ 为波长，单位 m；v 为波速，单位 m/s；f 为频率，单位 Hz。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The wave speed equation in terms of
frequency is f = v .
λ
back:
True.
The wave speed equation in terms of
frequency is f = v
λ
Where:
f = frequency, measured in hertz
(Hz)
v = wave speed, measured in
metres per second (m/s)
λ = wavelength, measured in
metres (m)
frontZh: 判断正误：由波速公式变形得到频率为 f = v / λ。
backZh: 正确。由 v = fλ 得到 f = v / λ。其中：f 为频率，单位 Hz；v 为波速，单位 m/s；λ 为波长，单位 m。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the equation linking time
period, T and frequency, f ?
back:
The equation linking time period, T and
frequency, f is:
T = 1
f
Where:
T = time period, measured in
seconds (s)
f = frequency, measured in hertz
(Hz)
frontZh: 周期 T 和频率 f 之间的公式是什么？
backZh: 周期和频率的关系为 T = 1 / f。其中：T 为周期，单位 s；f 为频率，单位 Hz。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term transverse wave.
back:
A transverse wave is a wave where the
oscillations are at right angles
(perpendicular) to the direction of
energy transfer.
frontZh: 定义术语“横波”。
backZh: 横波是振动方向与能量传递方向垂直的波。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are three examples of transverse
waves?
back:
Examples of transverse waves include:
ripples on the surface of water
vibrations on a guitar string
S-waves (secondary seismic waves)
electromagnetic waves
frontZh: 举出三个横波的例子。
backZh: 横波的例子包括：水面波纹、吉他弦上的振动、S 波（次级地震波）和电磁波。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term longitudinal wave.
back:
A longitudinal wave is a wave where the
oscillations are parallel to the direction
of energy transfer.
frontZh: 定义术语“纵波”。
backZh: 纵波是振动方向与能量传递方向平行的波。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What are three examples of longitudinal
waves?
back:
Examples of longitudinal waves are:
sound waves
P-waves (primary seismic waves)
pressure waves in liquids or gases
frontZh: 举出三个纵波的例子。
backZh: 纵波的例子包括：声波、P 波（初级地震波），以及液体或气体中的压强波。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Longitudinal waves can travel in a
vacuum.
back:
False.
Longitudinal waves require a medium
to travel through, so they cannot travel
in a vacuum since there are no particles
in a vacuum.
frontZh: 判断正误：纵波可以在真空中传播。
backZh: 错误。纵波需要介质才能传播；真空中没有粒子，所以纵波不能在真空中传播。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the name for the part of a
longitudinal wave where the particles
are close together?
back:
In a longitudinal wave, the area where
the particles are close together is called
a compression.
frontZh: 纵波中粒子靠得很近的区域叫什么？
backZh: 在纵波中，粒子靠得很近的区域叫做密部。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the name for the part of a
longitudinal wave where the particles
are spaced far apart?
back:
In a longitudinal wave, the area where
the particles are spaced far apart is
called a rarefaction.
frontZh: 纵波中粒子相距较远的区域叫什么？
backZh: 在纵波中，粒子相距较远的区域叫做疏部。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Visible light is an example of a
transverse wave.
back:
True.
Visible light is part of the
electromagnetic spectrum. All
electromagnetic waves are transverse
waves.
frontZh: 判断正误：可见光是横波的例子。
backZh: 正确。可见光属于电磁波谱，而所有电磁波都是横波。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Transverse waves can travel through a
vacuum.
back:
True.
Electromagnetic waves are transverse
waves and they can travel through a
vacuum. However, other types of
transverse waves such as water waves
and S-waves are mechanical waves that
require a medium.
frontZh: 判断正误：横波可以在真空中传播。
backZh: 正确。电磁波是横波，并且可以在真空中传播。不过，水波和 S 波等其他横波是机械波，需要介质。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the key difference between
transverse and longitudinal waves?
back:
The key difference between transverse
and longitudinal waves is the direction
of the vibrations with respect to the
direction of the energy transfer. For
transverse waves, the vibrations are
perpendicular to the direction of energy
transfer, while for longitudinal waves,
the vibrations are parallel to the
direction of energy transfer.
frontZh: 横波和纵波的主要区别是什么？
backZh: 主要区别是振动方向相对于能量传递方向的关系：横波的振动方向与能量传递方向垂直；纵波的振动方向与能量传递方向平行。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The highest point above the rest
position of a transverse wave is called
the peak of the wave.
back:
True.
The highest point above the rest
position of a transverse wave is called
the peak or the crest of the wave.
frontZh: 判断正误：横波中高于平衡位置的最高点叫做波峰。
backZh: 正确。横波中高于平衡位置的最高点叫做波峰。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the name of the lowest point
below the rest position of a transverse
wave? the trough.
back:
The name of the lowest point below
the rest position of a transverse wave is
frontZh: 横波中低于平衡位置的最低点叫什么？
backZh: 横波中低于平衡位置的最低点叫做波谷。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What type of wave is shown in the
diagram?
back:
The wave shown is a transverse wave
because it oscillates at right angles of
the direction of wave motion.
frontZh: 图中显示的是什么类型的波？
backZh: 图中显示的是横波，因为它的振动方向与波的传播方向成直角。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Sketch a longitudinal wave.
Include the following labels:
direction of vibration
direction of energy transfer
compression
rarefaction
back:
A correctly labelled longitudinal wave is
as follows:
frontZh: 画出一个纵波，并标注：振动方向、能量传递方向、密部、疏部。
backZh: 正确标注的纵波应显示：振动方向与能量传递方向平行，并标出密部和疏部。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term reflection .
back:
Reflection occurs when a wave meets a
boundary between two media and does
not pass through, but instead stays in
the original medium.
frontZh: 定义术语“反射”。
backZh: 反射是指波遇到两种介质的边界时，没有通过边界进入另一介质，而是留在原介质中传播。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: State the law of reflection .
back:
The law of reflection states that the
angle of incidence is equal to the angle
of reflection.
frontZh: 说明反射定律。
backZh: 反射定律说明：入射角等于反射角。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term refraction.
back:
Refraction occurs when a wave passes a
boundary between two different
transparent media and undergoes a
change in speed causing it to change
direction.
frontZh: 定义术语“折射”。
backZh: 折射是指波通过两种不同透明介质的边界时，由于速率改变而发生方向改变。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term diffraction .
back:
Diffraction is when waves pass around
an obstacle or through a narrow gap,
and the waves spread out.
frontZh: 定义术语“衍射”。
backZh: 衍射是指波绕过障碍物或通过窄缝后发生扩散的现象。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Diffraction only happens when the gap
the wave is passing through is smaller
than the wavelength of the wave.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
False.
Diffraction is greatest when the gap the
wave is passing through is of a similar
size to the wavelength of the wave. If
the wavelength is much greater than, or
much smaller than the gap then no
diffraction will occur.
frontZh: 判断正误：只有当缝隙小于波长时，波才会发生衍射。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。当缝隙大小与波长相近时，衍射最明显。如果波长远大于或远小于缝隙，衍射通常不明显。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The angle of incidence is measured
between the incident ray and the
boundary surface.
back:
False.
The angle of incidence is measured
between the incident ray and the
normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：入射角是在入射光线和边界表面之间测量的。
backZh: 错误。入射角是在入射光线和法线之间测量的。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The angle of reflection is measured
between the incident ray and the
normal.
back:
False.
The angle of reflection is measured
between the reflected ray and the
normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：反射角是在入射光线和法线之间测量的。
backZh: 错误。反射角是在反射光线和法线之间测量的。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the key difference between
reflection and refraction?
back:
Reflection is when a wave stays in the
same medium, while refraction is when
a wave passes into a different medium
and changes speed.
frontZh: 反射和折射的主要区别是什么？
backZh: 反射时，波留在同一种介质中；折射时，波进入另一种介质并改变速率。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The angle of incidence is equal to the
angle of refraction.
back:
False.
The law of reflection states that the
angle of incidence is equal to the angle
of reflection . In refraction, the angle
of refraction is dependent upon the
angle of incidence and the media
through which the wave travels.
frontZh: 判断正误：入射角等于折射角。
backZh: 错误。反射定律说明入射角等于反射角。折射时，折射角取决于入射角以及波传播经过的介质。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
How do you measure the angle of
refraction?
back:
The angle of refraction is measured with
a protractor between the refracted ray
and the normal.
frontZh: 如何测量折射角？
backZh: 折射角用量角器在折射光线和法线之间测量。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What types of wave behaviour can a
ripple tank be used to demonstrate?
back:
A ripple tank can be used to
demonstrate the following types of
wave behaviour:
reflection
refraction
diffraction
frontZh: 水波槽可以用来演示哪些波的行为？
backZh: 水波槽可以用来演示反射、折射和衍射。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The amount of diffraction depends on
the size of the gap compared to the
wavelength. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
The amount of diffraction depends on
the size of the gap compared to the
wavelength of the wave.
frontZh: 判断正误：衍射程度取决于缝隙大小与波长的比较。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。衍射程度取决于缝隙大小与波长之间的比较。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What happens to the wavelength of
water waves in a ripple tank when the
frequency is reduced?
back:
When the frequency of water waves in a
ripple tank is reduced, the wavelength
increases.
frontZh: 在水波槽中，如果水波频率降低，波长会怎样变化？
backZh: 在水波槽中，水波频率降低时，波长会增大。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
How do you decrease the wavelength of
water waves in a ripple tank?
back:
You decrease the wavelength of the
waves in a ripple tank by increasing the
frequency of the waves.
frontZh: 如何减小水波槽中水波的波长？
backZh: 通过增大水波频率，可以减小水波槽中水波的波长。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The image formed in a mirror is a real
image.
back:
False.
The image formed in a mirror is a
virtual image.
frontZh: 判断正误：镜子中形成的像是实像。
backZh: 错误。镜子中形成的像是虚像。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
An image formed in a plane mirror will
be smaller than the object.
back:
False.
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be the same size as the object.
frontZh: 判断正误：平面镜中形成的像比物体小。
backZh: 错误。平面镜中形成的像与物体大小相同。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: What is the normal?
back:
The normal is a line drawn
perpendicular (at 90°) to the boundary
of a material.
frontZh: 什么是法线？
backZh: 法线是垂直于材料边界的直线，与边界成 90°。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be the same distance behind the mirror
as the object is in front of it.
back:
True.
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be the same distance behind the mirror
as the object is in front of it.
frontZh: 判断正误：平面镜中形成的像到镜面后的距离等于物体到镜面前的距离。
backZh: 正确。平面镜中形成的像到镜面后的距离，等于物体到镜面前的距离。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Define the term angle of incidence for
light rays at the boundary of a material.
back:
The angle of incidence is the angle
between the incident ray and the
normal line at the boundary of a
material.
frontZh: 定义光线在材料边界处的入射角。
backZh: 入射角是在材料边界处，入射光线与法线之间的夹角。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be laterally inverted.
back:
True.
The image formed in a plane mirror will
be laterally inverted. The left hand side
of the object will appear on the right
hand side of the image and vice versa.
frontZh: 判断正误：平面镜中形成的像会发生左右反转。
backZh: 正确。平面镜中的像会发生左右反转；物体左侧看起来在像的右侧，反之亦然。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front: Define the term angle of reflection .
back:
The angle of reflection is the angle
between the reflected ray and the
normal at the boundary of a material.
frontZh: 定义术语“反射角”。
backZh: 反射角是在材料边界处，反射光线与法线之间的夹角。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The law of reflection applies to
reflection in plane mirrors.
back:
True.
The law of reflection is when the angle
of incidence is equal to the angle of
reflection and applies to a plane mirror.
frontZh: 判断正误：反射定律适用于平面镜反射。
backZh: 正确。反射定律说明入射角等于反射角，并适用于平面镜。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
An image formed in a plane mirror will
be virtual.
back:
True.
An image formed in a plane mirror will
be virtual.
frontZh: 判断正误：平面镜中形成的像是虚像。
backZh: 正确。平面镜中形成的像是虚像。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, what is the
independent variable? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror the
independent variable is the angle of
incidence.
frontZh: 在研究平面镜反射的实验中，自变量是什么？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在研究平面镜反射的实验中，自变量是入射角。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, what is the
dependent variable? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
The dependent variable in the reflection
investigation is the angle of reflection .
frontZh: 在研究平面镜反射的实验中，因变量是什么？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 在反射实验中，因变量是反射角。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, what
equipment is needed? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror the
equipment needed is:
a ray box
a protractor
a sheet of paper
a pencil
a ruler
frontZh: 研究平面镜反射实验需要哪些器材？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 研究平面镜反射需要：光线盒、量角器、纸、一支铅笔和一把尺子。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
Looking directly into a ray box the light
may damage the eyes. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
True.
Looking directly into a ray box light may
damage the eyes.
frontZh: 判断正误：直视光线盒的光可能伤害眼睛。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。直视光线盒发出的光可能伤害眼睛。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, what
results would you expect to find?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, the results
you would expect to find are that the
angle of reflection is equal to the angle
of incidence at all angles tested.
frontZh: 在研究平面镜反射的实验中，你预期会得到什么结果？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 预期结果是：在所有测试角度下，反射角都等于入射角。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What action should be taken if a light
ray box causes burns? (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
If the light ray box causes burns, the
burn should be held under cold running
water for at least five minutes.
frontZh: 如果光线盒造成烫伤，应采取什么措施？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 如果光线盒造成烫伤，应将烫伤处放在冷水下冲洗至少五分钟。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, which
factors should be controlled?
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, control
variables include:
distance of the ray box from the
mirror
width of the light beam
frequency/wavelength of the light
frontZh: 研究平面镜反射实验中应控制哪些因素？（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 控制变量包括：光线盒到镜子的距离、光束宽度，以及光的频率/波长。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, an error
could occur in measuring the angles of
incidence and reflection if the normal
lines are not drawn perpendicular to
the surface of the mirror. This is an
example of a systematic error.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Systematic errors are errors in the use
of apparatus or the experimental
method. Errors in measuring angles due
to drawing normal lines incorrectly are
systematic errors.
frontZh: 判断正误：如果法线没有垂直于镜面，入射角和反射角的测量会出错；这是系统误差的例子。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。系统误差来自仪器使用或实验方法。法线画错导致角度测量错误，属于系统误差。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
In an experiment to investigate
reflection by a plane mirror, a sharp
pencil should be used to mark the
centre of the beam to then draw the
ray. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Using a sharp pencil and marking the
centre of the beam to then draw the ray
will reduce random errors in the results.
frontZh: 判断正误：实验中应使用尖铅笔标记光束中心，再画出光线。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。用尖铅笔标记光束中心再画光线，可以减小结果中的随机误差。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the symbol for the angle of
incidence of a light ray on a boundary?
back:
The symbol for the angle of incidence of
a light ray on a boundary is i .
frontZh: 光线在边界处的入射角用什么符号表示？
backZh: 入射角的符号是 i。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What is the symbol for the angle of
refraction of a light ray on a boundary?
back:
The symbol for the angle of refraction of
a light ray on a boundary is r .
frontZh: 光线在边界处的折射角用什么符号表示？
backZh: 折射角的符号是 r。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
When light refracts by passing from a
less dense medium into a denser
medium, the ray bends away from the
normal.
back:
False.
When light refracts by passing from a
less dense medium to a more dense
medium, it bends towards the normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：光从较疏介质进入较密介质发生折射时，会偏离法线。
backZh: 错误。光从较疏介质进入较密介质时，会向法线偏折。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The frequency of light changes during
refraction.
back:
False.
The frequency of light does not change
during refraction.
frontZh: 判断正误：光在折射时频率会改变。
backZh: 错误。光在折射时频率不改变。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
When light passes along the normal,
perpendicular to the surface of a
medium, the ray does not change
direction.
back:
True.
When light passes along the normal,
perpendicular to the surface of a
medium, the ray does not change
direction.
frontZh: 判断正误：当光沿法线垂直于介质表面传播时，光线方向不改变。
backZh: 正确。当光沿法线、垂直于介质表面传播时，光线方向不改变。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
When light refracts by passing from a
denser medium into a less dense
medium, the ray bends toward the
normal. normal.
back:
False.
When light refracts by passing from a
denser medium into a less dense
medium, the ray bends away from the
frontZh: 判断正误：光从较密介质进入较疏介质发生折射时，会向法线偏折。
backZh: 错误。光从较密介质进入较疏介质时，会偏离法线。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What properties of light change during
refraction?
back:
During refraction, the speed and
wavelength of light change, but not the
frequency.
frontZh: 折射过程中，光的哪些性质会改变？
backZh: 折射过程中，光的速率和波长会改变，但频率不变。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
In a ray diagram of refraction through a
glass block, how many boundary
surfaces does the ray pass through?
back:
In a ray diagram for refraction through
a glass block, the ray passes through 2
boundary surfaces:
air-to-glass
glass-to-air
frontZh: 在玻璃砖折射光线图中，光线经过几个边界面？
backZh: 光线经过 2 个边界面：空气到玻璃、玻璃到空气。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
When light refracts through a glass
block, the incident ray at the boundary
of glass-to-air is the ray inside the glass.
back:
True.
When light refracts through a glass
block, the first boundary is air-to-glass,
and the second boundary is glass-to-air.
The refracted ray at the air-to-glass
boundary becomes the incident ray at
the glass-to-air boundary.
frontZh: 判断正误：光通过玻璃砖折射时，玻璃到空气边界处的入射光线是在玻璃内部的那条光线。
backZh: 正确。第一边界是空气到玻璃，第二边界是玻璃到空气；在空气到玻璃边界折射后的光线，成为玻璃到空气边界的入射光线。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
Define refractive index. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
The refractive index is the ratio of the
speed of light in a vacuum and the
speed of light in a material.
frontZh: 定义折射率。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 折射率是真空中光速与材料中光速之比。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The refractive index has no units.
(Extended Tier Only)
back:
True.
Since the refractive index is a ratio, it
has no units.
frontZh: 判断正误：折射率没有单位。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。折射率是一个比值，因此没有单位。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
When i < r, the refracted ray bends
toward the normal. (Extended Tier
Only)
back:
False.
When the angle of incidence i is less
than the angle of refraction r , or i< r,
the refracted ray bends away from the
normal.
frontZh: 判断正误：当 i < r 时，折射光线向法线偏折。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 错误。当入射角 i 小于折射角 r，即 i < r 时，折射光线偏离法线。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
State the equation for the refractive
index. (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The equation for the refractive index is
n = speed of light in a vacuum
speed of light in material
Where:
n = the refractive index
frontZh: 写出折射率的公式。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 折射率公式为 n = 真空中光速 / 材料中光速。其中：n 为折射率。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
True or False?
The value for the refractive index of a
material will always be less than the
speed of light in a vacuum. (Extended
Tier Only)
back:
True.
The value for the refractive index of a
material will always be less than the
speed of light in a vacuum.
frontZh: 判断正误：材料中的光速总是小于真空中的光速。（仅拓展内容）
backZh: 正确。通常材料中的光速小于真空中的光速；因此材料的折射率通常大于 1。
translationNotes: Reviewed/rephrased in V8 for natural Chinese physics classroom wording.
translationNotice: 中文翻译用于辅助学习，英文原文为准。

front:
What trigonometric function is used in
Snell's Law? (Extended Tier Only)
back:
The trigonometric function used in
Snell's Law is sine.
